pages.text: When placed, this expands into a large 3×3×3 slime block. The placement point shifts outward and searches nearby for a position that does not trap the player and has support on at least one face.$(br2)It can extend from floors, walls or ceilings, and no longer requires a floor beneath it.

Breaking any part removes the entire giant slime block and returns only one item.$(br2)When it collides with another Sable physical sub-level, contact faces within 30° are fixed immediately. Larger angles first create a breakable soft joint that gradually pulls the two faces into alignment before fixing them.
Adhesion only works on another physical structure and never sticks to blocks in the static world.$(br2)Roll the giant slime block across another physical structure to pull it along.
